org_research: The Berkeley Scanner is a local news site covering Berkeley, run by Emilie Raguso. It does not endorse candidates; this form builds a candidate profile that publishes to readers ahead of the election, so answers are read by voters rather than by an endorsement committee. The Scanner reports more than 254,000 monthly pageviews and a daily email list of more than 12,000. Every response is published, apart from the last field, which asks for a cell and email for the reporter's own use. Most answers are capped between 400 and 800 characters, so they need to be tight. The form also asks for campaign photos by email: at least one horizontal 4:3 featured photo (e.g. 1200x900px) and one that works as a headshot. Questions go to Emilie Raguso at emilie@berkeleyscanner.com or 510-459-8325.
